scope.reason: Recompute canonical paragraph text and inline projections from captured source material, preserving numeric superscript indices with caret delimiters. Re-read portal statute links against their anchor text: links whose provisions the anchor does not print lose them, links naming another act or a bare paragraph become plain text, and the metadata lists what was dropped. Also revalidates publisher head-matter ordering across the complete document AST; A clerk's closing mark printed after the decision is read as a publisher note rather than head matter; paragraph roles have no feature storage of their own.
